Offer details

*Offer available for a limited time and may be modified or discontinued at any time without notice. Plan pricing: Unlimited Premium is $65/mo per line for 1 line with AutoPay and $70/mo per line without AutoPay, plus taxes and fees. A $35 activation fee applies per line. The $800 off a new Pixelstone phone is applied as 36 monthly bill credits of $22.22 and requires an eligible trade-in and a new line on Unlimited Premium. Credit approval required for device financing. If you cancel service before all credits are applied, remaining credits will stop and the remaining device balance is due. The streaming bundle is included with Unlimited Premium only, renews automatically, and is billed at the standard rate of $9.99/mo if you change plans. To save $10/mo with AutoPay, you must enroll in AutoPay using a bank account or debit card; credit cards do not qualify for the AutoPay discount. Taxes and fees are calculated on the full retail price of the device at the time of sale. 5G Home Internet is $35/mo with any voice line on Unlimited Premium, $60/mo without a voice line, and is available in select areas only. Mobile hotspot includes 50GB of high-speed hotspot data per month, after which hotspot speeds are reduced to 600 kbps for the rest of the bill cycle. Customers who use more than 50GB of data in a month may notice slower speeds than other customers due to data prioritization. The 25% discount for military and first responders requires verification of eligibility within 30 days and applies to up to 5 lines. The offer of 4 lines for $100/mo requires you to switch at least 2 lines from another carrier and port in your existing numbers. Speeds and coverage are not guaranteed and vary by location, device, network congestion and other factors. Texting to 200+ countries is unlimited from the US only; picture messages and texts sent while roaming abroad are not included. Trade in any phone in any condition to get the full credit, which is applied over 36 months; the device must power on, and devices reported lost or stolen are not accepted. Video typically streams at standard definition unless you add an HD Day Pass. Price Lock means we will not raise the base monthly price of your plan for 3 years; it does not apply to taxes, fees, add-ons or promotional discounts. In-flight Wi-Fi is available on select airlines and routes with participating carriers, and video streaming in flight is not supported. The smartwatch line is free for 12 months via monthly bill credits; after 12 months it costs $10/mo unless you remove the line. Cloud storage for 6 months on us renews at $2.99/mo after the promotional period unless canceled. Limit one offer per account. Ridgeline Mobile may suspend or terminate service for misuse, including running servers, machine-to-machine connections or tethering beyond hotspot allowances. Device payment plans require a down payment for some customers based on credit, and the remaining balance is split into equal monthly payments. Bill credits begin within two bill cycles and are applied only while the line stays active and in good standing on an eligible plan. Promotional discounts cannot be combined with corporate, student or other employer discounts unless stated otherwise. Ridgeline Mobile reserves the right to change plan features, prices and network management practices; we will notify you at least 30 days before any change to your monthly price. Additional terms, including our network management policy, open internet disclosures and the customer agreement, are available in stores. All prices, plans and features on this page belong to the fictional Ridgeline Mobile and exist only in the Catchline unit test suite.
